steps.en: Officer searches by vehicle or ID number and ticks notices
steps.id: Officer mencari dengan nomor kendaraan atau ID dan mencentang notice

steps.en: The system checks each notice against the furnishable rules
steps.id: Sistem mengecek tiap notice terhadap aturan furnishable

steps.en: The screen lists only the furnishable notices
steps.id: Layar hanya menampilkan notice yang furnishable
steps.why_en: Non-furnishable notices stay in the selected list; the filter is switched off.
steps.why_id: Notice yang tidak furnishable tetap ada di daftar pilihan; saringan dimatikan.

steps.en: Notices that cannot be furnished are listed with a reason
steps.id: Notice yang tidak bisa di-furnish ditampilkan beserta alasannya

steps.en: The list shows key notice details and lets the officer drop rows
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan data kunci dan officer bisa membuang baris
